requirements.statement: Each block quotation uses a <blockquote> element.

citations.quote: Dans chaque page web, chaque bloc de citation utilise-t-il une balise `<blockquote>` ?
Retrouver dans le document les blocs de citation ;

routes.statement: The block quotation is structured with a <blockquote> element.

citations.quote: Pour chaque bloc de citation, vérifier que le bloc de citation est structuré au moyen d’un élément `<blockquote>` ;

rationale.text: The test applies to each block quotation, and finding quotations is judgment: no glossary entry defines one, and whether a block of text repeats someone else's words depends on its meaning, not on its styling. One route is accepted, a <blockquote> element. Code can see <blockquote> elements, but not the block quotations that lack one, so no check can show that every block quotation uses it, and no unmarked block is surely a quotation. An indented or italic block, or one between large quotation marks, may or may not be a quotation, so a check based on styling would carry little evidence and none is registered. No axe rule is tagged for this test. The wording asks only that block quotations use <blockquote>; whether <blockquote> is used for something else, such as indentation, is outside it. The candidate is none, with no link. Applicability is judgment, because whether the page holds a block quotation cannot be decided by code. Needs is empty.

citations.quote: Dans chaque page web, chaque citation est-elle correctement indiquée ?
Si c’est le cas pour chaque bloc de citation, **le test est validé**.
